question: A wavefront is moving from left to right in a uniform medium. At a later time, why is only the forward envelope of secondary wavelets taken as the new wavefront?

options.A: The new wavefront is obtained by joining the centres of all the secondary wavelets.
options.B: The backward envelope is chosen because secondary wavelets spread in all directions.
options.C: Any tangent surface to the secondary wavelets can be taken as the new wavefront.
options.D: The forward envelope is taken because it represents the next position of the advancing disturbance.
